title: An interview with Corning CEO Wendell Weeks on risk-sharing provisions that protect the company in multibillion-dollar fiber deals with Nvidia, Meta, and Amazon (Christopher Mims/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Christopher Mims / Wall Street Journal: An interview with Corning CEO Wendell Weeks on risk-sharing provisions that protect the company in multibillion-dollar fiber deals with Nvidia, Meta, and Amazon — CEO Wendell Weeks remembers the dot-com crash and other hardships, and those lessons help him hedge even the most optimistic data-center bets
